description: Agentic chat: a deliberately broad, corpus-wide report so the searchers pile a large shared context on the report writer, which then has to window it by token budget (createAgentTemplateParams splitByBudget -> TokensBudgetFluxCoordinator). This is a non-regression smoke: a report writer that cannot window a shared context bigger than one LLM window stops producing an answer - before the windowing fix an oversized single contribution looped instead of returning, so the run never completed. Which route the controller picks stays soft, as everywhere else in this suite.
